components.problem: Iteration-1 significance ceiling was the [simulated] regime. Iteration-2 question: does exact torus spectral KRR on REAL NOAA Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomaly fields (1856-2023, 36x72 5-deg grid, 2005 months; Nino3.4 index validated vs 1982/83, 1997/98, 2015/16 El Nino and 1988/89 La Nina) (a) reconstruct masked real fields with calibrated intervals and (b) forecast the real Nino3.4 index at h=1..12 against persistence/climatology/AR(1), under a future-blind temporal holdout? EXPECTED-RESULTS CEILING (stated): ENSO forecasting is a crowded field; this project does NOT claim state-of-the-art ENSO skill or method newness. The honest significance target is: a reproducible, fully CPU-only exact-spectral-KRR reconstruction + forecast benchmark on real data, with leakage-aware evaluation, calibrated (diagnostic) coverage, and skill comparisons against standard baselines -- a significance upgrade over iteration-1 solely through real-data validation and honest skill accounting.
components.method: (1) Core: exact torus spectral KRR unchanged (BCCB closed-form solve via two FFTs; spectral floor for non-PSD torus Grams, disclosed; exactness verified vs dense floored reference; free-boundary gap measured per kernel/grid; masked-input training via PCG with exact free-boundary BTTB matvec + floored-torus preconditioner). (2) One consistent spectral functional operator: the Nino3.4 box mean of any predicted field equals a spectral inner product with the box indicator (Parseval identity); the SAME operator yields the reconstruction box functional and the forecast index -- reconstruction and forecast share one kernel and one operator; box integration commutes with the FFT machinery by linearity. (3) Frequency-domain transfer forecast (extension, honestly scoped): per-Fourier-mode ridge mapping Y_t -> Y_{t+h}: H_h(f) = argmin ||Y_{t+h}(f) - H Y_t(f)||^2 + lam_h|H|^2 over train-only modes; index forecast = spectral functional of the transfer-filtered spectrum. (4) Leak control (normative): every fit -- monthly climatology, AR(1), per-mode ridge H_h and its ridge lam_h, kernel spectra -- is built EXCLUSIVELY from train-block data (<= 2015-12); forecasts use rolling origins with all material <= origin; the circulant wrap is spatial-only (per-field), no temporal wrap crosses the 2015-12/2016-01 seam; the 2015/16 El Nino is confined to the test window and verified absent from all fits.
components.experiment_design: Data: real Kaplan v2 (results/raw/real/). Split: train <= 2015-12 (1920 months), test 2016-01..2022-12 (84 months); hyperparameters via temporal-block CV inside train. (1) P0 pilot exactness on real fields. (2) T1a masked reconstruction: random 10/30/50% + halo w1/2/4 masks; LOFO held-out months; mask ratio FIXED and mirrored across train/test; evaluation on held-out cells only (no leakage from masked cells); metrics RMSE + skill vs train-only monthly climatology; intervals: CALIBRATION PROTOCOL acknowledged as non-exchangeable -- split-conformal with calibration set = the 5 temporal blocks immediately preceding the test window (rolling-origin calibration); reported coverage is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a guarantee; coverage and width reported per mask spatially and per fold temporally. (3) T1b masked-input exact-free PCG (10/30/50%), RMSE on masked cells. (4) T2 functional index regression: spectral box functional in temporal-block CV vs zero-model (train-box mean) and direct RBF head. (5) T3 forecast h in {1,3,6,12}: spectral transfer vs persistence, train-only monthly climatology, train-only AR(1); metrics per horizon RMSE/MAE/corr + climatology skill score + Diebold-Mariano (year-block bootstrap) significance vs each baseline; rolling-origin evaluation (all fits train-only at every origin). (6) B baselines: sklearn exact-subsample/Nystrom/RFF on real pooled cells. (7) S scaling unchanged. Resource axes on every artifact; budget: per-arm worst-case estimates -- T3 = 12 horizons x ~2000 rolling origins x 2 FFTs (36x72) (~0.1 s total), B = sklearn exact n=10k (~6 s), full pipeline < 90 min on 12 cores, peak RSS << 7 GB; all artifacts carry dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2.
